R420.note: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) before the delete, matching the existing show/update pattern and the policy's delete method; nothing else changed.

R421.note: Magic-byte check on the stream with the extension derived from the detected type, file still GUID-named outside the webroot; replacing the ContentType check is stated and rejects no legitimate image.

R422.note: Secure = true added to the existing CookieOptions; single-line fix, no other change.

R423.note: Same as R420: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) inserted before the delete with no other change.

R424.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode on ticketRef at the Response.Write sink; HtmlEncode(null) yields null so the missing-parameter output is unchanged.

R425.note: Keys now come from a fixed JWKS URL via IssuerSigningKeys, closing the jku vector, but the added ValidAlgorithms = RS256-only restriction (plus a one-time constructor fetch with no key rotation) can reject tokens the original accepted and the contract does not call for it.

R426.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() with the OrderContext passed as root keeps property reads and arithmetic while rejecting T(), constructors, beans and method calls, exactly the stated contract.

R427.note: Exception message replaced with a fixed 'Invalid order ID format' body; status code and success path unchanged.

R428.note: rawComment is HTML-escaped in the formatter where it is interpolated, using the same escaper already applied to authorName; rename of the helper is stated and behaviour-neutral.

R429.note: Removing proc_open entirely closes the injection, but file() slurps the whole daily log into memory where grep streamed it, so a large log now hits memory_limit and fails; the write-up claims 'identical functionality' and does not state this.

R430.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => [ShoppingCart::class]]) keeps the cookie wire format and the existing instanceof fallback; disallowed classes become __PHP_Incomplete_Class and fall through to a fresh cart.

R431.note: password_verify() is the right API, but the case stores plaintext (the == comparison worked against it), so every existing login now fails until the column is rehashed; the write-up states the hashed-storage prerequisite but offers no migration, so stated-but-blocking.

R432.note: escape-html applied to closingNote at the point of interpolation; also escaping ticket.subject/status is stated as defence-in-depth and renders the case's plain-text values identically.

R433.note: bcrypt.compare against user.passwordHash with a dummy-hash fallback and the !user check after the compare, so a dummy-preimage match cannot log in; the passwordHash field name is an unverified assumption since the User model is not in the case, and the unknown-user message changing to 'Invalid credentials' is stated enumeration hardening.

R434.note: IAntiforgery injected and ValidateRequestAsync(context) called before UpdateEmailAsync, the correct explicit check for a JSON-bound minimal API; the new header requirement is the fix and is stated.

R435.note: encode_entities($cgi->param('note')) puts param() in list context, so a request with two note values passes the second as encode_entities' unsafe_chars set and the first is emitted unencoded (reproduced with HTML::Entities in scratch: encode_entities('<script>alert(1)</script>','x') returns the payload verbatim); the ticket_id line, assigned in scalar context, is fixed correctly.

R436.note: GetRelativePath + StartsWith('..') closes the sibling-prefix bypass, but GetRelativePath returns the input unchanged (no exception) when roots differ, so a rooted userFile on another drive or a UNC path (D:\..., \\host\share) now passes where the original StartsWith rejected it, and a legitimate file named '..foo' inside uploads is now refused; the write-up's claim that drive mismatches throw is wrong.
